title: Phone Calls with Twilio: ElevenLabs Native Integration
desc:
Put your ElevenLabs voice agent on a real phone line. This episode explains the two kinds of Twilio numbers the native integration supports, how to import a number with an Account SID or a safer API key, how to assign an agent for inbound calls, how to place an outbound test call, and how batch calling works: CSV or XLS recipient lists, dynamic variables, override columns, scheduling and concurrency.

This episode is a documented walkthrough built from the official ElevenLabs documentation (links below). It does not include a live product recording.
